  > Playwright, and code-review gate. When a PR is clean and every GitHub check passes, squash-merge it automatically and
  > continue to the next slice until you need a decision or credential from me.

content.text: The first slice will be the report-ingress boundary: lost-pet clients can obtain the same constrained private upload grant used for found pets, finalize an optional image with the report, persist only the finalized object name, and publish contact-redacted payload v4. The decoder and notification path will continue accepting raw/v1, v2, and v3. Asynchronous analysis and matcher deferral remain separate follow-up PRs, so this slice is deployable and rollback-safe on its own.
